title: DI String Match
description: Given a string S containing only 'I' (increase) and 'D' (decrease), return any permutation A such that A[i] < A[i+1] if S[i] == 'I', and A[i] > A[i+1] if S[i] == 'D'.

steps.note: Initialize low pointer at 0 and high pointer at n (length of string 'ID' is 2).
Char is 'I', push low (0) and increment low to 1.
Char is 'D', push high (2) and decrement high to 1.
Loop finished, push remaining low (1) to array.
